What changed

Document360 Lotus: docs as code

TodayThe GitHub extension syncs one way, main branch only
With LotusA new project type that syncs GitHub and Document360, both ways

Developers commit Markdown and review in pull requests. Writers and PMs edit in Document360 with no GitHub account. Every change publishes as one reviewed commit, and conflicts are resolved in the editor.
